verdict.rationale: Parahelp's Customer Agent works as a team member inside Intercom, Zendesk, Front, Plain and Pylon, or standalone via the API. Its ticketing connection both ingests resolved tickets and replies as a support agent, with Pylon setup using an API token, a reply-as user and a webhook signing secret, which implies two-way flow. However, Salesforce, which the story names, is never mentioned, and bidirectional sync of tickets and context is only implied rather than documented in depth. missing for 10: Salesforce integration, explicit documentation of two-way ticket/context sync (field/status/tag writeback), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the agent runs inside my existing helpdesk — Zendesk, Salesforce, Intercom — or standalone, syncing tickets and context both ways

citations.quote: Your Customer Agent works as a team member in Intercom, Zendesk, Front, Plain, or Pylon.
